d: India A registered a massive 306-run victory over Nepal in their ACC Men's Asia Cup Rising Stars 2026 Group B clash. Kumar Kushagra (117) and captain Tilak Varma (107) starred with centuries to help India A post 332/9. In reply, Prince Yadav (5/6) and Harshit Rana (4/16) dismantled Nepal's batting lineup, bowling them out for just 26 in 11.3 overs, the fifth-lowest total in List A cricket history.
